questions.question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Tortoise, Mammal, Amphibian
questions.solution:
The Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between Tortoise, Mammal, and Amphibian is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/240f6db20903e6add641b327135fdc3c611c607e67c3b7151f64643506849ddf.png] 

Tortoise is a reptile.

There is a difference between tortoises and turtles.

Tortoises dwell on land, while turtles live in the water.

An animal of the type that gives birth to live babies, not eggs, and feeds its young on milk from its own body are called mammals.

Amphibians are small vertebrates that need water, or a moist environment, to survive. The species in this group include frogs, toads, salamanders, and newts.

Hence, ‘option 1’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which of the following combinations of words best represents the Venn diagram given below ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cb47d258544d9591df8171176f1d3d0b67edbae673c507ad12324f562853c7f.png]
questions.solution:
The combinations of words which best represents the Venn diagram given below is 'Females, Daughters, Sisters'

Some daughters are sisters and vice - versa.

All sisters and daughters are female.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd7830b59e7aa349e2654a19fcfaeda9bb84f09cd982214f645b4cd6f1b5251f.png] 

Hence, '**Females, Daughters, Sisters**' is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

Fathers, Doctors, Males

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89a4df0ab0aa16baf9a33524f67859d2c519aa4325a9324f115e2be1b5c4622d.png] 

All Fathers are Males condition satisfied (Outer circle - Male, Inner circle - Fathers)

Assuming second coinciding inner circle as shown in question as Doctors will mean All Doctors are male and some doctors are fathers that is not followed.

Some Doctors can be male and father but not all.

Hence 2nd option does not satisfy the condition.
